verdict.rationale: Plausible documents built-in funnel analysis: you define a sequence of steps, see how many visitors complete each one, and find where they drop off. It offers sequential and strict-order funnel types, and steps can be goals or custom events, so activation steps can be modelled. The dashboard is pitched as usable without training, which fits a founder working without an analyst. Older community comments about missing user-flow tracking concern path exploration rather than fixed funnels, so they do not concretely contradict the funnel capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of funnels working in practice, and evidence of deeper drop-off breakdowns (segmenting funnel steps by source or property, time-to-convert) suited to in-product activation analysis.
